findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_manufacturability, check_order_status · Public sink: find_hole_operations, create_upload, upload_status, create_quote, check_order_status · Destructive: check_manufacturability, configure_part, get_sheet_rules, update_quote_parts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_manufacturability, check_order_status · Public sink: find_hole_operations, create_upload, upload_status, create_quote, check_order_status · Destructive: check_manufacturability, configure_part, get_sheet_rules, update_quote_parts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
